problem_summary.summary: Find the one array value occurring once when every other value occurs exactly three times.
problem_summary.input_output: Input: a nonempty integer array nums. Output: its single-occurrence value.
constraints: Exactly one value occurs once and every other value occurs three times
The required solution has linear runtime and constant extra space

brute_force.explanation: Count values in a hash map and return the key with frequency one. It is a clear baseline, but the map exceeds the requested constant extra space.
brute_force.correctness_idea: The input guarantee makes the unique value the only value whose recorded frequency is one.
brute_force.time_complexity: O(n) expected with hash map operations, where n = nums.length.
brute_force.space_complexity: O(u), where u is the number of distinct values; this is not constant extra space.

optimized.explanation: Track bit positions that have appeared once in ones and twice in twos. For every number, update these masks and clear any bit that has now appeared three times. After all values, ones holds the unique number's bit pattern.
optimized.correctness_idea: For each bit position independently, the two masks encode its occurrence count modulo three: neither mask means zero occurrences, ones means one, and twos means two. A third occurrence clears both masks. Thus triplicated values vanish and the single value remains. Bitwise operations work on the complete two's-complement representation, including negative inputs.
optimized.time_complexity: O(n), with a fixed number of bitwise operations per value.
optimized.space_complexity: O(1) auxiliary space, using three fixed-width integer masks.

steps.condition: Each bit of this value has now appeared once.
steps.action: Update the masks; no bit has reached three occurrences.

steps.condition: The bits set in -2 have now appeared twice.
steps.action: Move those bits from ones into twos.

steps.condition: ones & twos identifies the bits reaching three occurrences.
steps.action: Clear those bits from both masks.

steps.condition: The bits of 5 have appeared once.
The bits of 5 have appeared twice.
The bits of 5 have reached three occurrences.
Its bit pattern has appeared once and is not canceled.
steps.action: Store its two's-complement pattern in ones; the array is exhausted.

edge_cases.handling: Triplicated values cycle their masks back to zero, and the returned ones mask remains zero.
The masks process all 32 two's-complement bits, so the negative value's original bit pattern is retained.

edge_cases.case: Triplicated values have set sign bits
edge_cases.handling: The same per-bit modulo-three state transition handles the sign bit as every other bit.
